integrity: All hypotheses and singular boundary cases are explicitly stated; exact arithmetic verification supplements a complete analytical proof. The claim is restricted to one exceptional edge in otherwise equilateral complete metric networks.
scientific_limitations: A closed family-classification, not an optimum over arbitrary edge weights or arbitrary graphs. Historical priority remains uncertain because a pertinent 1982 article was not available in full text.
title: A three-tier intrinsic diameter law for one-edge-deformed complete networks
